description: This file defines the Preferences data model class used in the account features of a Flutter application. It includes properties for various user preferences, and methods for creating default preferences, copying with modifications, serializing to and from JSON.

classes.name: Preferences
classes.description: A data model class representing user preferences with properties like analytics, personalization, marketing, social media toggles, and an update timestamp.

methods.name: Preferences
methods.description: Constructor for creating a Preferences instance with required fields.

methods.name: defaults
methods.description: Returns a Preferences object with default values for preferences.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Preferences object, optionally overriding certain fields.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Preferences instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Preferences object to a JSON map.
